264167.l: Oxymeris albida, common name: the white auger, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Terebridae, the auger snails. This Indo-Pacific species is characterized by its slender, high-spired shell with distinct white coloration and brown banding patterns. Like other terebrids, O. albida is a venomous predator that uses a specialized radular tooth to immobilize polychaete prey. The species is commonly found in sandy substrates of shallow tropical waters from East Africa to French Polynesia.
